business_problem: replace siloed spreadsheets and legacy systems with a unified data architecture that could improve safety, compliance, and rig performance across mining operations.
solution_summary: Topdrill uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace siloed spreadsheets and legacy systems with a unified data architecture that could improve safety, compliance, and rig performance across mining operations. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so operations and engineering teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with Tableau so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Topdrill achieved 95%+ improvement in compliance and 99% faster when performing safety checks.
